disorder-name.detail: Autism spectrum disorder; clinical cohort from ABIDE dataset, N=576 after exclusion
disorder-name.supporting_text: "we analyzed individuals with ASD and typically developed (TD) controls (total n = 1218) aged 5 -40 years"

dataset-of-origin.detail: Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange; the paper refers to 'ABIDE' without specifying I or II. Before exclusion: 659 ASD and 836 TD (1495 total) from 17 sites.
dataset-of-origin.supporting_text: "Using a world-wide multi-site database known as Autism Brain Imaging Data Exchange"

sex.detail: Exact male/female counts for the ASD group are not reported. The overall study sample (ASD+TD, N=1218) has a male-to-female ratio of approximately 5:1 as stated in the Limitations section, but per-group sex breakdown is not provided.
sex.supporting_text: "it also has few female participants, with a male-to-female ratio of approximately 5:1"
